newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Pratt & Whitney sees SIA JV sales over US$200 mln.
newsitem.headline: Pratt & Whitney sees SIA JV sales over US$200 mln.

text.p: United Technologies unit Pratt & Whitney (P&W) said on Tuesday it expected revenues from its joint venture with Singapore Airlines Ltd's (SIA) engineering unit to exceed US$200 million a year.
James Taiclet, vice president of Pratt & Whitney Eagle Services, told reporters at a signing ceremony that the joint venture would effectively double his company's engine overhaul revenues.
The joint venture, which is expected to be operational by November 1997, would be Pratt & Whitney's first joint venture for engine overhauls outside the United States.
The company was also looking to set up an overhaul facility in Europe for the European and Middle East region, he said.
